skill.name: Avengerang
skill.description: Akshan throws a boomerang that deals damage going out and coming back, extending its range each time it hits an enemy.

skill.name: Power Fist
skill.description: Blitzcrank charges up their fist to make the next attack deal double damage and pop their target up in the air.

skill.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
skill.description: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

skill.name: Ixtal's Impact
skill.description: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.

skill.name: Impale
skill.description: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.

skill.name: Breath of Light
skill.description: Aurelion Sol channels his dragon breath for a few seconds, damaging the first enemy hit and splashing reduced damage onto nearby enemies. Each second the breath is channeled directly at an enemy will deal bonus damage, which is improved by the amount of Stardust that's been collected. This ability collects Stardust if the target is a champion.

passive.name: Noxian Diplomacy
passive.description: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

skill.name: Thundering Smash
skill.description: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, <status>Stunning</status> and damaging the first one he Attacks.

skill.name: Sky Splitter
skill.description: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.

skill.name: Mortal Steel
skill.description:
Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.

On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward with a gust of wind knocking enemies Airborne.
